title: Keiou Yuugekitai: Katsugeki-hen
overview:
The time: the end of the Edo period, the 9th year of Keiou.

A fun yet greedy adventure in pursuit of the vast treasure handed down from the land of Yamatai begins now!

Rami & Pochi, guardians of the secret treasure; Dr. Pon, the genius tanuki; and Himiko, the 13th queen of Yamatai - who will get their hands on the treasure in the end!?

時は幕末、慶応9年
邪馬台国伝来、莫大な財宝目当ての楽しくもいやしい冒険がいま始まる!

秘宝の守人蘭未&ぽち、天才タヌキDr.ポン、邪馬台国13代女王ひみこ、果して財宝を手に入れるのは誰か!?
